ending.solidarity.title: Solidarity
ending.solidarity.desc: The family held on to each other. The factory changed, but they did not lose one another.
ending.separation.title: Separation
ending.separation.desc: No one harmed anyone. But everyone went their own way.
ending.bitter_reckoning.title: Bitter Reckoning
ending.bitter_reckoning.desc: Someone paid the price for this shift. Karaliman will not forget.
ending.betrayal.title: Betrayal
ending.betrayal.desc: A name was given. After that, no table was ever the same.
ending.secret.title: Secret Ending: The Silent Table
ending.secret.desc: All three alive, all three at the same table. And none of them says a word.
ch00.title: Test: Morning Tea
ch00.l01: Karaliman, twenty to six in the morning. The factory whistle hasn't blown yet, but the whole neighbourhood is awake.
ch00.l02: Dad, early shift again? It's not even light out.
ch00.l03: The new robot line goes live today. The final check is on us.
ch00.l04: Everyone at school is talking. They say once the line runs, they won't need maintenance crews.
ch00.c01.truth: It's true. Maybe half of us will go.
ch00.c01.reassure: Don't worry, someone has to fix the machines.
ch00.c01.deflect: Mind your exam. The rest is my business.
ch00.r01_truth: Then I'll find a job too. I'll drop school for a year.
ch00.r01_reassure: I hope so. But your voice says otherwise.
ch00.r01_deflect: You always say that. And then nobody ever tells me anything.
ch00.r01_silence: Kemal stirred his tea. The sound of the spoon lasted longer than any sentence.
ch00.l05: A truck horn outside the door. Rıza is early again.
ch00.l06: Kemal, brother! I'm heading to the port, I'll pass the factory. Hop in, we need to talk.
ch00.l06_no_kemal: Defne… I came about your father. We need to talk.
ch00.l07_angry: Go. You weren't going to tell me anything anyway.
ch00.c02.ask: Talk about what? Say it here.
ch00.c02.defne_ride: Let's drop Defne at school too.
ch00.r02_ride: Something's off with the port cargo, brother. Unsealed containers. Have you heard anything?
ch00.r02_ride_b: I haven't. And I don't want to, Rıza.
ch00.r02_bus: Suit yourself. But taking the shuttle won't make this go away.
ch00.r02_ask: Not here. In this neighbourhood even the walls have ears.
ch00.r02_defne: Thanks, Rıza. Dad never asks anything anyway.
ch00.r02_defne_b: Your father doesn't ask, kid. But he knows everything.
ch00.r02_silence: Kemal didn't answer. Rıza shrugged and drove off.
ch00.l09_warm: The streetlights went out. The day hadn't started badly.
ch00.l09_cold: The streetlights went out. Nobody wished anybody a good day.
ch00.l09_neutral: The streetlights went out. A new shift was starting in Karaliman.
journal.ch00.automation: The robot line goes live today. Half the maintenance crew may be made redundant.
journal.ch00.containers: Rıza mentioned unsealed containers at the port.
ch01.l01: The night shift is leaving, the morning shift coming in. The locker room smells of tired boots and machine oil.
ch01.l02: Final check. The line opens tomorrow. If we miss something today, nobody will forgive it tomorrow.
ch01.obj.locker: Get ready for the shift: open your locker, then head to the floor.
journal.ch01.photo: Defne's ninth-grade photo is in my locker. Back then she had no exam nerves.
ch01.it.own_locker.l1: Defne's ninth-grade photo. She's still smiling in this one.
journal.ch01.selim_baby: An ultrasound photo on Selim's locker: 'October'. His baby is due in October.
ch01.it.selim_locker.l1: An ultrasound photo taped to the door. Under it, in pen: 'October'.
journal.ch01.flyer: A notice about an automation meeting. Someone wrote underneath in red: 'First the machines, then us.'
ch01.it.notice_board.l1: 'Automation transition briefing.' Underneath, in red pen: 'First the machines, then us.'
ch01.l03: Kemal! Your work order is on my desk. Cell three, final check. I want a signature by noon.
ch01.r00_ok: Good. This line is everyone's future, don't forget.
ch01.r00_push: It will. If not, we'll find someone who can.
ch01.r00_silence: Kemal didn't answer. Nevin had already turned away.
ch01.obj.floor: Pick up the work order from Nevin's desk, then talk to Selim.
journal.ch01.work_order: The work order says 'Sensor calibration: OK'. I haven't even looked yet.
ch01.it.work_order.l1: Cell 3, welding robot. 'Sensor calibration: OK.' Who wrote that? I haven't checked it yet.
journal.ch01.layoff_list: 'Restructuring: maintenance unit.' Twelve names. Fourth: Selim Aksoy.
ch01.it.layoff_list.l1: 'Restructuring: maintenance unit.' Twelve names. Fourth on the list: Selim Aksoy.
ch01.it.layoff_list.l2: Selim… His baby's due in October.
journal.ch01.fault_log: Cell 3 error log: the sensor warning fired 23 times, all muted by hand.
ch01.it.robot_panel.l1: Error log… The sensor warning fired twenty-three times. Every one muted by hand.
ch01.it.selim.locked: Work order first, or Nevin will start again.
ch01.l04: Boss! How about the new arm, handsome, right? In a week it'll weld faster than me.
ch01.l05: Just kidding. There'll still be work for us, right? Someone has to fix the machine.
ch01.c01.warn: I saw the list. Your name's on it, Selim.
ch01.c01.hint: Get yourself a plan B. I mean it.
ch01.c01.joke: Being faster than you isn't hard.
ch01.c01.ask: Who calibrated this arm? On paper everything's fine.
journal.ch01.night_crew: According to Selim, the night crew muted the sensor warnings.
ch01.r01_warn: What? … Are you sure? The baby's coming in October, Kemal.
ch01.r01_warn_b: Don't tell anyone you heard it from me. But be ready.
ch01.r01_hint: Plan B? You know something, don't you.
ch01.r01_joke: Ha. You're about to retire anyway.
ch01.r01_ask: The night crew, I think. It kept beeping, so they muted it. To make the opening.
ch01.r01_silence: Kemal couldn't say a thing. Selim patted his shoulder and went back to the line.
ch01.l07: The welding arm is in test mode. Kemal opens the safety gate and steps in. With someone inside, the arm should stop.
ch01.r_q_ok: The arm passed a hand's width above Kemal's head. The sensor never reacted.
ch01.r_q_fail: The steel arm slammed into Kemal's shoulder. Pain first, then anger.
ch01.l09_injured: The sensor's dead. Today a shoulder, tomorrow someone's head.
ch01.l09: The sensor's dead. If the line opens like this, someone gets hurt.
ch01.l10_injured: Kemal! What happened to your shoulder? … Fine, infirmary later. I need that signature; the ministry comes tomorrow.
ch01.l10: Kemal? I'm waiting for that signature. The line opens tomorrow morning; the ministry is coming too.
ch01.c02.prompt: What will you do about the hidden fault?
ch01.c02.report: I'm filing an official report. The line can't open.
ch01.c02.evidence: The logs are right here: they muted the warning twenty-three times.
ch01.c02.fix: I'll sign. But I'll stay tonight and replace the sensor myself.
ch01.r02_report: A report? If I send this up, the first thing they'll ask is who to add to the list.
ch01.r02_evidence: …Who else has seen this? Fine. The opening is postponed. But there will be a price, Kemal.
ch01.r02_fix: Nevin relaxed. That night Kemal didn't go home; Defne's message went unanswered.
ch01.r02_sign: Thank you. This is best for everyone.
ch01.r02_silence: When Kemal stayed silent, Nevin signed it herself: 'Silence counts as yes.'
ch01.l_end_warned: At the gate Selim gave Kemal a long look. Gratitude or fear, it was hard to tell.
ch01.l_end: The end-of-shift whistle blew. In cell three, the arm waited quietly for tomorrow.

journal.title: Journal
ch02.title: Chapter 2: The Strike
loc.ch02.loc_d: Factory gate · First morning of the strike
ch02.l01: Two hundred people at the gate. Flasks, banners and Karaliman's wet cold.
ch02.l02: The school bus passes at half seven. The exam is in two weeks. But here I am.
ch02.l03: Defne! Kemal warned me, we know about the list now. This time we're ready!
journal.ch02.ch02_flyer: Union statement: 'Yes to automation, no to layoffs.'
ch02.it.ch02_flyer.l1: Statement: 'Yes to automation, no to layoffs.' Below it, twelve blank signature lines.
ch02.it.ch02_banner.l1: 'First the machines, then us.' The line from Dad's locker room, written huge.
journal.ch02.ch02_selim: The gate key is with maintenance. With Dad.
ch02.it.ch02_selim.l1: The gate key's with maintenance, you know that? So if your dad opens it, it opens.
ch02.x01.objective: Walk the picket line, then talk to Selim.
ch02.c01.support: Take the mic: 'Our fathers' jobs are our future.'
ch02.c01.mediate: 'No fighting. Let's sit down with management.'
ch02.c01.leave: Go to school. This isn't your fight.
ch02.c01.prompt: The committee calls you to the microphone
ch02.r01_support: Applause. Someone at the back shouted 'Kemal's girl!' Defne's hands were shaking.
ch02.r01_mediate: Some nodded, some whistled. The middle was the coldest place to stand.
ch02.r01_leave: Defne got on the bus. She looked at the crowd one last time through the window.
ch02.r01_silence: Defne took the mic but no word came out. The crowd filled the silence with chants.
ch02.l03k: Kemal, you've got the key. Rıza's truck is waiting. No parts, no line tomorrow either.
ch02.l03k_v1: Kemal. The opening's postponed, thanks to you. But the parts still go in. You have the key.
ch02.l04k: Everyone I know is out there.
ch02.l04k_v1: My daughter's out there at the mic. Am I the one who opens this gate?
ch02.l04k_v2: Defne went to school. Good. At least she won't see this.
ch02.c02.riza_only: Let only Rıza's truck in, then shut it.
ch02.r02_open: The chain fell. A roar rose from the crowd, then only truck engines.
ch02.r02_closed: You'll answer for this upstairs, Kemal.
ch02.r02_riza: Thanks, brother. I won't forget it. This load… we'll talk later.
ch02.r02_silence: Kemal didn't move. The guards took the key from his hand and opened the gate themselves.
ch02.outro: As evening fell, the strike entered its second night.
ch02.outro_v1: Defne saw her father behind the gate. Two sides of the same gate.
ch03.title: Chapter 3: The Port
ch03.l01: The port works at night too. Cranes work, trucks work. Questions don't.
ch03.l02: Container forty-seven. No seal, the waybill says 'cleaning supplies'. Night delivery to the plant.
ch03.l02_v1: Kemal opened the gate for me. Now I'm the one hauling forty-seven in there.
journal.ch03.ch03_seal: Container 47's seal was cut and glued back.
ch03.it.ch03_seal.l1: The seal's been cut, then glued. Amateur job.
journal.ch03.ch03_manifest: Consignee: Demirtaş Logistics. The plant director's brother-in-law's company.
ch03.it.ch03_manifest.l1: Consignee: 'Demirtaş Logistics'. Demirtaş… the director's brother-in-law.
ch03.it.ch03_crane.l1: The operator shouted down: 'Rıza! Nobody wanted forty-seven. Don't you either.'
ch03.it.ch03_dispatcher.l1: The dispatcher cracked the window and held out an envelope: 'Rıza, this load isn't asked about. Take it and go.'
ch03.x01.objective: Look the cargo over. The dispatcher is waiting in the office.
ch03.c01.open: Open the container and see for yourself.
ch03.q01.prompt: Guard coming, pull the door shut!
ch03.r_seen: A flashlight hit his face. 'Rıza? I saw you. I won't forget.'
ch03.r_open: Barrels. Twenty barrels of thinner. That's their 'cleaning supplies'. Enough to burn a factory down.
ch03.r_call: Don't open it, Rıza. Take a photo, send it to me. Tell no one.
ch03.r_dont: What you don't know can't burn you. That's what they say.
ch03.c02.hide: Drive to the old depot and hide the load.
ch03.c02.tip: Deliver it, but send the photo to Defne.
ch03.r_deliver: The truck went in through the plant's back gate. Nobody counted the barrels.
ch03.r_hide: The old fish depot. Nobody looks there. If they do, they'll find me.
ch03.r_tip: Sent. The girl's smart. She'll know what to do.
ch03.r_silence: Before Rıza could decide, the dispatcher's men climbed in and drove the load off themselves.
ch04.title: Chapter 4: The Family Home
loc.ch04.loc: Kemal's flat · The night before the exam
ch04.l01: Radio in the kitchen, silence in the living room. Rıza came for dinner, but nobody is eating.
ch04.l02: Exam tomorrow, right? Get to bed early.
ch04.l02_v1: My shoulder? It's nothing. Mind your studies.
ch04.it.ch04_exam_card.l1: Tomorrow, 09:30. I studied a whole year for this.
journal.ch04.ch04_meds: Dad's painkillers. The box is nearly empty.
ch04.it.ch04_meds.l1: Painkillers. Almost gone. 'It's nothing,' he said.
journal.ch04.ch04_letter: A letter from the plant to Dad.
ch04.it.ch04_letter.l1: Company letterhead. 'Disciplinary inquiry' or 'opening bonus': you don't need to read it, your father's face says which.
journal.ch04.ch04_coat: There was a thick envelope in Rıza's coat.
ch04.it.ch04_coat.l1: A thick envelope. Rıza doesn't get paid in envelopes.
journal.ch04.ch04_phone: Photo from Rıza: twenty barrels of thinner going to the plant.
ch04.it.ch04_phone.l1: A photo from Rıza. Barrels. Underneath: 'Keep this.'
ch04.x01.objective: Look around the flat. Talk to your dad when you're ready.
ch04.c01.truth: Tell me the truth, Dad. What did you sign?
ch04.c01.accuse: You stood behind the gate. Everyone saw.
ch04.c01.riza: Rıza, what's the envelope in your coat?
ch04.c01.prompt: What will you say to your father?
ch04.r_truth: Whatever I signed, I signed to keep you in school. That's not an answer, I know.
ch04.r_truth_v1: I hid the fault. So the line would open. I was wrong, girl.
ch04.r_truth_v2: I reported the fault. Now they're investigating me. It was the right thing.
ch04.r_support: Your mother used to say that. Come here.
ch04.r_accuse: They saw. And which side of the gate would you stand on? Who would pay the bills?
ch04.r_riza: That envelope… I shouldn't have taken it. I'll give it back tomorrow. I promise.
ch04.r_silence: Defne said nothing. On the radio, the forecast: rain tonight, fog in the morning.
ch04.c02.exam: Sit the exam. It's your future.
ch04.c02.father: Be with your father on the night shift.
ch04.r_exam: Half nine. Tonight I sleep. I'll try to.
ch04.r_father: I filled the flask, Dad. I'm coming with you tonight.
ch04.r_strike: The picket starts at two. I'll be at the plant.
ch04.r_sleep: Defne fell asleep at her desk, on her book. Sleep made the decision.
ch05.title: Chapter 5: Night Shift
ch05.l01: The line is quiet. Too quiet.
ch05.l01_v1: A spark from cell three, then smoke. Then flames.
ch05.f01_v1: The sensor… the one I signed off. Everybody out!
journal.ch05.ch05_extinguisher: The extinguishers on the night shift were empty.
ch05.it.ch05_extinguisher.l1: Empty! It's empty! Who signed off on this?
ch05.it.ch05_fusebox.l1: Power's off. At least the arm stopped.
ch05.fx.objective: Fire: find your way, follow the voices.
ch05.f_c1.go_out: Get out, wait for the fire brigade.
ch05.f_c1.prompt: Two voices: Defne from the office, Selim from the cell
ch05.f_esc_ok: Kemal made it out of the smoke.
ch05.f_esc_ok_v1: Kemal carried Defne out of the smoke. Behind them, Selim's voice stopped.
ch05.f_esc_ok_v2: Kemal came out with Selim over his shoulder. The office side was in flames.
ch05.f_esc_fail: A falling beam crushed Kemal's leg. He crawled out.
ch05.f_esc_fail_v1: His injured shoulder gave out. Kemal fell two steps from the door and never got up.
ch05.f_out: Kemal got out. The voice inside went quiet before the fire brigade came.
ch05.f_sacrifice: Kemal couldn't choose; he went back for both. He pushed Selim to the door. He didn't make it out himself.
ch05.r01: The loading door's locked! There are people inside!
ch05.r01_v1: I brought those barrels. I hauled this fire in. And the door's locked!
ch05.r_c.ram: Ram the wall with the truck.
ch05.r_c.flee: Back the truck out and leave.
ch05.r_c.call: Call the fire brigade, guide them in.
ch05.r_ram_ok: The wall came down. Coughing strikers ran out of the smoke toward the headlights.
ch05.r_ram_fail: The truck broke the wall, but the cab stayed in the flames. Rıza never came out.
ch05.r_call: The back ramp! Come in by the back ramp! Hurry!
ch05.n01: Someone's by cell three. Holding a jerrycan.
journal.ch05.ch05_fusebox_n: Cell three's wiring had been pulled. It was meant to look like an accident.
ch05.it.ch05_fusebox_n.l1: The wiring's been pulled. Someone wants this to look like an accident.
ch05.n_stop: Jerrycan and paperwork in the same hand. 'Demirtaş Logistics.' This is no accident now.
ch05.n_hurt: The man swung the can into Kemal's face and ran. But there was no fire.
ch05.n_report: Police are on the way. He ran, but the can's still here.
ch05.n_away: Kemal turned away. The guards came before the man could finish; nobody saw anything.
ch05.nr01: No fire. For now. But the barrels are still out there.
ch05.nr01_v1: The barrels in the depot. Hand them to the police, or sell them back to Demirtaş?
ch05.nr_police: First time in my life I walk into a police station on my own.
ch05.nr_sell: Money is money. But this money stinks.
ch05.nr_keep: I'll wait. In this town the one who waits wins. So they say.
ch05.d01: I'm in the office. Something's wrong, I can feel it.
ch05.d01_v1: The office is full of smoke! Dad! Where are you?
ch05.d_dead: Defne never reached the office door.
ch05.d_c.help: Drop the phone, help people out.
ch05.d_rec: Barrels, pulled wires, the locked door. It's all here.
ch05.d_help: This way! Toward the wall, stay low!
ch05.d_freeze: Defne froze. The phone shook in her hand; record was never pressed.
ch05.d_out: Defne read the news on her phone after the exam.
ch05.d_out_v1: Defne sat the exam. She would hear about the night at the plant the next day.
ch05.outro: The fire brigade worked until morning. Cell three was left as charcoal.
ch05.o_k: By morning Kemal's helmet lay by the gate, wet and ownerless.
ch05.o_r: Rıza's truck stayed in the wall, its door open.
ch05.o_d: The next day, one desk in Hall 4 stayed empty.
ch05.o_n: When the morning shift arrived, the line was still there. Nobody asked about the night.
ch06.title: Chapter 6: The Informant
ch06.l01: Sit down. There was an attempted sabotage at the plant. I want a name.
ch06.l01_v1: Sit down. If the fire was an accident, nobody's to blame. If it wasn't, I want a name.
ch06.dl_k: Kemal's overalls still hang behind the door.
ch06.dl_d: Defne's exam card is still on the desk, unfolded.
ch06.dl_r: Rıza's truck sits at the port. Nobody dares to drive it.
ch06.dl_s: Selim's baby will never know its father.
journal.ch06.ch06_file: The commissioner's file has three names: Kemal, Defne, Rıza.
ch06.it.ch06_file.l1: Three names in the file. A question mark beside each.
ch06.it.ch06_box.l1: Evidence bags: photos, recordings, error logs. Some of it you brought in.
ch06.it.ch06_window.l1: Reporters outside. Camera lights reflect on the glass.
ch06.x01.objective: Look around the room, then face the commissioner.
ch06.c01.blame: Blame the company: the evidence is right here.
ch06.r_confess: The secret was spoken. The room seemed smaller for a moment.
ch06.r_confess_v1: I took the envelope. I told the director about the strike meetings. I hauled the barrels too.
ch06.r_confess_v2: I knew about Rıza's envelope. I kept quiet. For my father.
ch06.r_confess_v3: I knew about the fault. I checked cell three. I knew what I was doing.
ch06.r_inform: Thank you. Nobody will know where I heard this name.
ch06.r_blame: Demirtaş Logistics… This file is going to grow.
ch06.r_silence: Silence is a statement too. I'm putting it on record.
ch06.r_speak: Karaliman made the evening news. For the first time, in the workers' own words.
ch06.r_hide: The back door opened onto a wet alley. Nobody was waiting.
ch06.r_lawyer: The union lawyer came late, but came.
ch06.a01: All three are gone. The inquiry is closed. There's nobody left to ask who informed.
ch07.title: Chapter 7: Reckoning
loc.ch07.loc_defne: Kemal's flat · The night before the last shift
loc.ch07.loc_kemal: Kemal's flat · The night before the last shift
loc.ch07.loc_riza: Kemal's flat · The night before the last shift
ch07.rc1: Selim's baby was born in October. It will never know its father.
ch07.rc2: Selim found a new job. He texts Kemal every morning.
ch07.rc3: The strike broke the day the gate opened. The union lost twelve people.
ch07.rc4: The gate stayed shut. Management had to come to the table.
ch07.rc5: Where the barrels came from made the papers.
ch07.rc6: Everyone knows who informed. Nobody says it.
ch07.rc7: An investigation was opened into Demirtaş Logistics.
ch07.rc8: The sensor Kemal fitted in secret that night still works.
ch07.rc9: A secret was told. It can't be taken back.
ch07.dl_k: Kemal's overalls still hang behind the door.
ch07.dl_d: Defne's exam card is still on the desk, unfolded.
ch07.dl_r: Rıza's truck sits at the port. Nobody dares to drive it.
ch07.dl_s: Selim's baby will never know its father.
journal.ch07.ch07_photo: All three are smiling in the photo on the wall. Nobody remembers when it was taken.
ch07.it.ch07_photo.l1: The three of them together by the sea. Nobody remembers when it was taken.
ch07.x01.objective: Walk around the flat. Sit at the table when ready.
ch07.c01.kd: Kemal and Defne: father and daughter.
ch07.c01.dr: Defne and Rıza: the envelope and the barrels.
ch07.c01.kr: Kemal and Rıza: an old friendship.
ch07.c01.none: Nobody talks. Let the wounds close themselves.
ch07.r_kd: I should never have left you on the other side of that gate.
ch07.r_dr: I knew about the envelope, Rıza. But you brought the barrels, and you told.
ch07.r_kr: Thirty years, brother. Is one night going to end that?
ch07.r_none: The tea went cold. Nobody spoke first.
ch07.c01s.stay: Stay in Karaliman and demand answers.
ch07.r_stay: There was nowhere to go anyway. Answers would be demanded here.
ch07.r_go: The suitcase was packed. But on the morning of the last shift, the feet still went to the gate.
ch07.c02.alone: Everyone does as they see fit.
ch07.c02.leave: Go one last time before leaving.
ch07.c02.prompt: The plan for the last shift
ch07.r_together: Six in the morning, the same door, together.
ch07.r_leave: The ticket is in the pocket. But first, the gate.
ch07.a01: We're gathering at the gate to remember Kemal, Defne and Rıza. Anyone who wants can come.
ch07.a02: The line opened. The robots work. Every morning I walk past those three names.
ch08.title: Chapter 8: The Last Shift
ch08.l01: The board will announce it: the line is closing, the robots are going to another city.
ch08.l01_v1: Because of the inquiry, the board is here. They'll speak in front of everyone.
ch08.l02: Suitcases at the gate. But they came one last time.
ch08.dl_k: Kemal's overalls still hang behind the door.
ch08.dl_d: Defne's exam card is still on the desk, unfolded.
ch08.dl_r: Rıza's truck sits at the port. Nobody dares to drive it.
ch08.dl_s: Selim's baby will never know its father.
ch08.it.ch08_gate.l1: The chain is back. Half the banner is torn: 'First the machines…'
journal.ch08.ch08_memorial: Candles and photos by the gate.
ch08.it.ch08_memorial.l1: Candles and photos. The wind put a few out; someone lit them again.
ch08.x01.objective: Walk the gate one last time. Approach the board when ready.
ch08.c01.expose: Reveal the evidence in front of everyone.
ch08.c01.alone: Turn around and go your own way.
ch08.c01.prompt: The board is at the gate. Everyone is looking at you

ep01.l01: The robots went to another city. The people didn't.
ep01.l02: Where cell three stood there's a workbench now. The neighbourhood's broken washing machines, tractor engines, school radiators.
ep01.l02_v1: After the inquiry the company left the building. The cooperative rented old cell three with the compensation money.
ep01.f_kemal: Kemal teaches the apprentices how to keep a fault log. 'Don't hide it,' he says. 'Write it down.'
ep01.f_kemal_v1: Kemal's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep01.f_kemal_v2: Kemal is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep01.f_defne: Defne is at college on weekdays and at the bench on weekends. Every technical drawing is hers.
ep01.f_defne_v1: Defne's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep01.f_defne_v2: Defne is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep01.f_riza: Rıza drives the cooperative's only truck. He never signs for a container without looking inside anymore.
ep01.f_riza_v1: Rıza's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep01.f_riza_v2: Rıza is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep01.sel: Selim brings his daughter sometimes. She sleeps under the bench, used to the sound of screws.
ep01.sel_v1: Selim's wife brings a pot of food every month. Nobody talks about it; everybody eats.
ep01.it.ep01_sign.l1: The sign is hand-painted. One letter is backwards; nobody wanted to fix it.
ep01.it.ep01_photos.l1: Where the layoff list used to hang there are photos now. Strike day, the night of the fire, the first customer.

ep02.l01: Three different addresses are written on the boxes. None of them is Karaliman.
ep02.l01_v1: They decided over dinner one evening. Nobody objected; that was what hurt most.
ep02.it.ep02_boxes.l1: One box says 'fragile'. Inside there's only an old teacup.
journal.ep02.ep02_wall: The family photo left a pale rectangle on the wall.
ep02.it.ep02_wall.l1: The photo is gone. Only a pale rectangle is left on the wall.
ep02.it.ep02_keys: Put the key on the table
ep02.x01.objective: Walk the flat one last time. Leave when you put down the key.
ep02.c01.prompt: The key is in your palm
ep02.f_kemal: Kemal is a night watchman at a shipyard on the coast. His postcard says only 'I'm fine'.
ep02.f_kemal_v1: Kemal's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep02.f_kemal_v2: Kemal is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep02.f_defne: Defne studies in another city. She reads her father's messages but doesn't answer.
ep02.f_defne_v1: Defne's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep02.f_defne_v2: Defne is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep02.f_riza: Rıza drives trucks across the border. He buys a postcard in every port and never sends one.
ep02.f_riza_v1: Rıza's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep02.f_riza_v2: Rıza is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep02.o01: In Karaliman the line closed. The chain on the gate rusted. Nobody came back.
ep02.o01_v1: One key is still in a pocket. The door is still the same door.

ep03.n01: Three names. And Selim. Is that what a factory costs?
ep03.n01_v1: Three names. Selim is alive, but he can't walk through this gate anymore.
ep03.n02: Master Kemal taught me to keep a fault log. I'll teach my daughter.
ep03.n03: The board sent a plaque. The company's name was written larger than the names.
ep03.n03_v1: The court found the company guilty. The fine was less than a week's profit.
ep03.l01: Candles by the gate. This time nobody puts them out.
ep03.f_kemal: Kemal comes to the gate every morning. The factory is closed; he still comes at six.
ep03.f_kemal_v1: Kemal's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep03.f_kemal_v2: Kemal is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep03.f_defne: Defne stands in front of the marble. In her hand, an exam result she hasn't opened.
ep03.f_defne_v1: Defne's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep03.f_defne_v2: Defne is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.
ep03.f_riza: Rıza sold the truck. Nobody would take the money; he spent it on candles.
ep03.f_riza_v1: Rıza's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep03.f_riza_v2: Rıza is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.

ep03.it.ep03_gate.l1: The chain has been cut. The gate is closed, but not locked.
journal.ep03.ep03_flyer: A corner of the strike flyer is still on the wall: 'People first.'
ep03.it.ep03_flyer.l1: Only a corner of the flyer is left: 'People first.'

ep04.l01: The last signature. Then a new city, a new name. Nobody will look for you.
ep04.l02: Nobody is waiting outside. If anyone were, they wouldn't look at you.
ep04.f_kemal: Kemal never says the name. There's no extra plate on the table anymore.
ep04.f_kemal_v1: Kemal's name is on the marble by the gate. Every morning someone polishes it.
ep04.f_kemal_v2: Kemal is still inside. Letters go out every month; the answers come back a little shorter each time.

ep04.f_defne_v3: Defne now lives in another city under another name. The old one stayed in Karaliman.

ep04.it.ep04_window.l1: Below, the factory chimney. No smoke. There never will be again.
journal.ep04.ep04_box: Three files in the evidence box: Kemal, Defne, Rıza. One is empty.
ep04.it.ep04_box.l1: Three files. One is empty, because its owner walks out of here free.
